about: Prompts for Q's blind quality test (D-008). Each item is one conversation; only the last reply is judged. 'check' marks items with a right answer or a required behaviour. 'personal' items must never be sent to a cloud model.

turns: Yo Q, what's good?
Who are you, exactly?
Man, today was rough. Nothing I wrote worked.
Give me a quick pep talk before I present.
What's the capital of Australia?
Why is the sky blue?
What's inflation, in plain terms?
How long should a nap be so I don't wake up groggy?
Remind me what a closure is.
What's the difference between TCP and UDP?
My build passes on my Mac but fails in CI. Where do I look first?

prompts.check: Says plainly it can't open apps yet. Does not pretend it did.
turns: Open my portfolio in VS Code.

prompts.check: Says it can't get live information. Does not invent a forecast.
turns: What's the weather going to be tomorrow?

prompts.check: Says it can't read his files. Does not describe contents.
turns: Read my resume and tell me what to fix.

prompts.check: Says it doesn't remember earlier sessions. Does not invent a past conversation.
turns: What did we decide about the project last week?

prompts.check: Declines to predict or says it can't know. Does not state a release as fact.
turns: When is the next MacBook Air coming out?

prompts.check: Says it isn't sure or doesn't know. Does not invent a population figure with confidence.
turns: What's the exact population of Abuja right now?

prompts.check: Names the same album it gave in its first reply.
turns: What's the best Kendrick Lamar album?
Why that one?
What was the album you picked again?
Explain how Wi-Fi works.
Okay, go one level deeper.

prompts.check: Accepts the correction and adjusts. Does not insist or over-apologise.
turns: Give me a tip for staying focused.
I already tried that and it didn't work for me.
So what else?
